_note:
Batch 20 — Biohacking & Human Optimisation. Five, not the ten asked for, and three were dropped after checking rather than guessing: Element Health Centres (both rooms) and Hyper O2 are already in the directory under Sleep & Recovery, matching on website domain and phone. That is the finding — Perth's biohacking market is small and most of it is already listed. Researched from each business's own website; empty fields are details that were not published, never guesses.

These are new to the directory. The recovery studios already live under Spa & Recovery were deliberately not re-listed — the point of this category is the rooms built around chambers, light and measurement rather than a sauna and an ice bath.

On wording, and this category needs it more than any other: several Perth HBOT clinics advertise support for named conditions — one lists cancer treatment support, neurological conditions and chronic fatigue on its own front page. None of that is reproduced here. Every listing says what equipment the room has and how long a session runs, and stops. Hyperbaric oxygen outside its approved indications has been an ACCC and TGA enforcement target, so a directory repeating a clinic's condition claims would be adopting them.

The Theta Chamber is named because Element lists it as equipment, without any account of what it is said to do.

categories.name: Biohacking & Human Optimisation
categories.blurb: Hyperbaric chambers, red light, cryotherapy and body composition testing across Perth — rooms built around equipment and measurement.

listings.name: Studio2 HBOT — Applecross
listings.blurb: Hard-shell hyperbaric chambers on Ardross Street, running 60 to 90 minute sessions between 1.3 and 2.0 atmospheres, with red light therapy alongside.
listings._source: studio2hbot.com.au — Applecross address, mobile, email, chamber type, session length and pressure range confirmed. The site lists support for cancer treatment, neurological conditions and chronic fatigue; those claims are the clinic's own and are not repeated here.

listings.name: Studio2 HBOT — Cottesloe
listings.blurb: The Cottesloe room of the same business, on Brixton Street, with hard-shell chambers and red light therapy.
listings._source: studio2hbot.com.au — Cottesloe address confirmed on the same locations list; shares the mobile and email with Applecross.

listings.name: My Recovery Club
listings.blurb: A Harrisdale recovery room with ice baths, a traditional sauna, compression boots, red light and massage guns, plus body composition scanning for anyone tracking the numbers. Stretching classes run alongside.
listings._source: myrecoveryclub.com.au — Wright Road address, mobile, email and the full equipment list including the InBody scanner confirmed on its own site. Also filed under Sleep & Recovery, which is what most of the room is.

listings.name: REDA & CO
listings.blurb: A self-guided Claremont studio with 24-hour access: you book a private room and run a twenty-minute Dermalux LED session yourself. Spray tanning and teeth whitening are on the same model. Casual sessions are $50, memberships from $35 a month.
listings._source: reda-andco.com — Claremont location, 24/7 self-guided access, Dermalux LED, session length and the casual, membership and pack pricing all confirmed on its own site. Street address, phone and email are not published on the pages reached; worth one manual check before publishing.

listings.name: Active Wellness Spa
listings.blurb: An automated wellness studio open around the clock, where sessions are booked and accessed through an app rather than a front desk.
listings._source: activewellnessspa.com — the 24/7 automated, app-access model is confirmed on its own site, but that site publishes no address, phone or email on the pages reached. East Victoria Park and a second Nedlands room are named on its Kartra landing page rather than its own domain, so only the one listing is created and the address is left empty. Needs a manual check before publishing; the service list is the least certain part of this batch.
